name: Group Metadata
description: Group metadata includes attributes like name, permissions, purpose, and associated user accounts or roles, which adversaries may exploit for privilege escalation. Examples: - Active Directory: `Get-ADGroup -Identity "Domain Admins" -Properties Members, Description` - Azure AD: `Get-AzureADGroup -ObjectId <GroupId>` - Google Workspace: `GET https://admin.googleapis.com/admin/directory/v1/groups/<groupKey>` - AWS IAM: `aws iam list-group-policies --group-name <group_name>` - Office 365: `GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/groups/<id>` *Data Collection Measures:* - Cloud Logging: - AWS CloudTrail for IAM group-related activities. - Azure AD Sign-In/Audit logs for metadata changes. - Google Admin Activity logs for API calls. - Directory Logging: Log metadata access (e.g., Windows Event ID 4662). - API Monitoring: Log API calls to modify group metadata (e.g., Microsoft Graph API). - SIEM Integration: Centralize group metadata logs for analysis.
